notes.title: Dadda Mini Patch...
notes.notes:
Hi everyone and thanks to all of you that have played Dadda so far!

I've seen that some players are finding the control scheme a little tricky, so I've added a simple text prompt system to provide tips for the opening scene and help new players to progress.

I've also reduced the disc size of the project by optimising video file sizes.

Finally I've added some timed lighting effects and shadows which should affect performance minimally whilst adding a lot to the atmosphere of the experience.

Thanks again and I hope these changes will improve your playtime!

James
